MotoMainte is an app that helps you easily record and manage your motorcycle maintenance history.

"When was my last oil change?"
"How many kilometers ago did I clean the chain?"
"When is my next maintenance due?"

MotoMainte helps you keep track of your motorcycle maintenance.

Record not only the service date and odometer reading, but also expenses, notes, and photos. You can review your complete maintenance history and maintenance costs at any time.

You can also set maintenance intervals by mileage or days for each maintenance item, making it easy to know when your next service is due.

**Main Features**

**Vehicle Management**

* Manage multiple motorcycles
* Register vehicle photos
* Track odometer readings
* Store owner's manuals (Web / PDF)

**Maintenance Management**

* Oil changes
* Chain cleaning
* Tire replacement
* Brake maintenance
* Other maintenance records

**Maintenance History**

* Record service dates and mileage
* Record expenses
* Save notes
* Attach photos
* View maintenance history
* Duplicate previous records to create new maintenance entries

**Maintenance Schedule**

* Manage by mileage or days
* Check upcoming maintenance
* View elapsed mileage and days since the previous service
* Receive maintenance reminders

**Customization**

* Add, edit, and delete maintenance items
* Customize icons and colors
* Customize displayed information

Whether you commute, ride on weekends, or enjoy touring, MotoMainte helps you keep your motorcycle maintenance organized.

*Maintenance intervals vary depending on the manufacturer, model, and riding conditions. Please configure them appropriately for your vehicle.*

Looking for an all-in-one motorcycle app that can help you plan your next trip and ensure your safety on the road? Look no further than Detecht! Whether you're a experienced rider or just starting out, Detecht has got you covered. With a range of features designed specifically for motorcyclists, Detecht is the ultimate app to help you stay safe, plan & navigate your routes, and connect with other riders.

The #1 app for people who love riding.

Safety Comes First

One of the most important features of Detecht is its safety tools. With automatic crash detection, safety tracking, and hazard warnings, you can ride with confidence, knowing that Detecht is always looking out for you. Our Automatic Crash Detection system will alert your emergency contacts in the event of an accident, while Safety Tracking keeps you connected to your loved ones with real-time location sharing. Our Hazard Warnings system will notify you of any potential hazards along your route, so you can stay alert and avoid accidents.

Plan Your Next Adventure

With Detecht's Route Planning features, you can create and navigate the perfect trip with just a few taps. Whether you're looking for curvy routes or round trips, Detecht has got you covered. Our planning tool makes it easy to customize your trip based on your preferences with stops, waypoints, and more. You can also explore over 250,000 user tracked routes to find the one that's right for you. The app allows you to plan your route in advance and ride it with our turn-by-turn GPS navigation and voice guidance, so you can focus on enjoying the ride when you're on the road. 

Connect with Other Riders

Detecht's motorbike community is a great way to connect with other riders. Our Social Feed lets you find riding buddies, share your experiences, and stay up to date on the latest news and trends. Take part in the discussions, chat with fellow riders, share routes, and plan your next adventure together.

Other Handy Features

In addition to the safety, route planning, and community features, Detecht also offers other handy tools for motorcyclists. The app supports GPX file formats, making it easy to import and export routes, while the ride statistics feature lets you track your progress and see how far you've come. These tools are perfect for serious riders who want to keep track of their progress and see how they're improving over time.

In summary, Detecht is the ultimate mobile app for motorcyclists, offering a range of features that cater to the needs of all riders. Whether you're a seasoned rider or just starting out, Detecht is the app you need to take your riding to the next level.

Detecht premium is available as an optional upgrade with three different periods, 1 month, 6 months and 12 months. You can subscribe and pay through your App Store account. Moto Shed is a motorcycle maintenance tracker and service log built for riders who want to organize their motorcycle garage, track repairs, log fuel, and never miss critical maintenance. It also works great for tracking cars, trucks, and other vehicles in your garage.

Increase your resale value, stay ahead of maintenance, and generate a professional service history in seconds. Moto Shed is a clean, ad-free maintenance app designed for riders and vehicle owners who want complete control of their service records, parts, and ownership costs.

Track maintenance, fuel usage, upgrades, and reminders for every motorcycle and vehicle you own.

Motorcycle Maintenance and Service Logging
Record oil changes, tire replacements, valve adjustments, chain service, repairs, upgrades, and parts. Create a complete service history with mileage, parts, labor, and detailed notes so you always know exactly what has been done to your motorcycle, car, truck, or other vehicle.

Fuel and Mileage Tracking
Log fuel fill-ups and fuel costs while tracking long-term mileage and fuel economy trends. Understand how your riding and driving habits affect fuel usage and ownership costs.

Smart Maintenance Reminders
Never forget important service again. Set reminders for oil changes, tire replacement, valve checks, belts, chain maintenance, inspections, insurance, and registration. Alerts can be based on time, mileage, or both. You can also create fully custom maintenance items for any vehicle.

Custom Maintenance Tracking
Track anything you want, not just predefined service items. Create custom repairs, upgrades, inspections, modifications, or recurring maintenance tasks tailored to your motorcycle, car, truck, or project vehicle.

VIN Recall Monitoring
Enter your motorcycle VIN to receive automatic NHTSA recall alerts and safety notifications so you stay informed about manufacturer recalls that may affect your bike.

Cost and Ownership Tracking
Moto Shed automatically tracks parts, labor, fuel, and repairs so you can understand the true cost of owning your motorcycle and other vehicles over time.

Garage Organization
Store everything related to your vehicles in one place including photos, part numbers, owner manuals, service notes, and documentation.

Professional Sales Report
Generate a clean PDF service history report when selling your motorcycle or vehicle. A detailed maintenance record helps build buyer confidence and can increase resale value.

Full Data Control
Export your service history via CSV. Backup and restore your garage using JSON when switching devices so your data always stays under your control.

Flexible and Personalized
Customize service intervals, categories, maintenance items, reminders, and alerts to match your motorcycle, vehicle, and maintenance habits. Choose from multiple themes and organize your garage the way you prefer.

Built for Every Garage
Moto Shed works for sport bikes, cruisers, touring motorcycles, dirt bikes, scooters, electric motorcycles, cars, trucks, SUVs, and project vehicles.

Global Support
Moto Shed supports miles or kilometers, multiple currencies, and 10 languages including English, Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, French, German, Vietnamese, and Portuguese.

Keep your maintenance history organized, track ownership costs, and make sure your bikes and vehicles always run their best with Moto Shed.

https://global.yamaha-motor.com/business/mc/connectivity/


CONFIRMED COMPATIBILITY WITH
iOS 17 and UP
 
CONFIRMED USABLE DEVICES 
Smartphones 
*Compatibility/usability checks are conducted under set conditions. Please be aware that the app may not function properly with all smartphones or operating systems.  
 
NOTES ON USAGE 
• The app and its features are all free to use, but any fees resulting from downloading the app itself and any data transmitted while using it will be borne by the user. 
• The app can only be used with models equipped with a Yamaha Communication Control Unit (CCU). 
• You must connect your motorcycle to the app via Bluetooth before using the app. Refer to your motorcycle’s Owner’s Manual. 
• Only errors that generate error codes are detected by the app. 
• The app will not track your motorcycle if it has been moved from its last parking location. 
• The app uses your smartphone’s GPS and Bluetooth functions, which may drain battery life faster. 
• Some smartphones may be disconnected from the app due to battery or power-saving settings. Check your smartphone’s user manual or provider for details. 
• Creating an account with YamahaMotorID is required to use the app. 
 
WARNING! 
• Always stop the vehicle before operating your smartphone. 
• Never take your hands off the handlebars while riding. 
• Always concentrate on riding by keeping your eyes and mind on the road. 
• Read the owner's manual carefully before operating the vehicle. 

Y-Connect app asks for the following device permissions as needed:
• Camera: To scan vehicle’s QR code
• Contacts: To select from phone contacts where to send malfunction notice
• Location: To pair the vehicle and utilize the map
• Phone: To display incoming call on the meter panel
• Files: To change vehicle’s image
